title: Gamblers enhanced
description: This project adds gambling games and chips, this includes cards and even a copper waiter.
body:
Casino Expansion Mod – Description

Bring a full casino experience into Minecraft with this fun and interactive gambling-themed mod packed with new mechanics, decorations, and unique gameplay features.


New Stackable Red Chips

This mod adds Red Casino Chips, a brand-new currency item that can be stacked and collected. Use them throughout the casino to buy drinks, trade with special NPCs, and build your own gambling setup.



Copper Waiter (Craftable NPC)

Craft your own Copper Waiter, a stylish version of the Copper Golem wearing a fancy casino suit.

The Copper Waiter has smart behavior:

Automatically searches nearby for empty drink containers.
If it detects you have empty drinks, it will walk directly toward you.
You can interact with him to buy fresh drinks using Red Chips.
After serving players, he will return to his assigned home location, where he stays until needed again.

It acts like a fully automated casino service NPC for your builds.


Card Deck

A brand-new Deck of Cards item has been added.

Special abilities:

When you hit with the deck, it gives a random playing card.
The generated card can be placed on blocks like decoration so players can see exactly which card it is.
You can also hit other players, forcing them to receive a random card too.
Great for custom poker games, blackjack tables, and multiplayer casino challenges.


Functional Casino Furniture

Decorate your casino with new themed building blocks including:

Custom Casino Table Blocks for poker, blackjack, and gambling setups.
A Seat Block that players can actually sit on, perfect for realistic casino interiors.
Designed to create fully interactive casino environments.


Wearable Suit Armor Set

Dress like a true high roller with the new Suit Armor Set.

Features:

Elegant formal suit appearance.
Fully wearable armor pieces.
Perfect for casino owners, dealers, or roleplay servers.
